source.capture_scope: One already-recorded Gemini 3.5 Flash ruling per hunter domain. No new model call was made for this expansion.
source.sanitisation: Gemini verdicts, confidence, reasoning, cited filenames and model labels are copied from the private ledger. Live principals, resource names, private hashes, byte counts, memory IDs, trace IDs and payload locations are omitted. SDLC, HR and vendor inputs are explicitly relabelled as fixtures. Public evidence hashes are recomputed over the sanitised summaries.

evidence.name: cc6-105-iam-bindings-2026-08-29.json
evidence.summary: Sanitised metadata from the recorded private run: live GCP IAM bindings were collected, but the artifact did not prove that a quarterly access recertification was performed or signed off.

ruling.reasoning: The provided evidence 'cc6-105-iam-bindings-2026-08-29.json' contains only a list of active GCP IAM bindings. It does not contain any evidence of a quarterly access recertification review being performed, signed off, or completed by authorized personnel as required by the control.
ruling.blocking_question: Please provide evidence of the completed quarterly access recertification review showing that the active access list was reviewed and approved by authorized managers within the last 90 days.

evidence.name: a1-3-cloud-asset-buckets-2026-08-29.json
evidence.summary: Sanitised metadata from the recorded private run: Cloud Asset Inventory listed two Storage buckets, but the artifact did not prove that recovery procedures were tested.

ruling.reasoning: The only artifact provided, 'a1-3-cloud-asset-buckets-2026-08-29.json', merely lists Google Cloud Storage buckets in a GCP project. It contains no evidence of recovery testing procedures, disaster recovery tabletop exercises, backup restoration tests, or any other proof that system recovery plans are tested.
ruling.blocking_question: Please provide evidence demonstrating that recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery have been tested within the last 365 days.

evidence.name: cc1-3-security-training-completion.json
evidence.summary: Labelled fixture from the recorded private run: all 48 employees completed the SEC-101 2026 training course, but the artifact did not document organisational structure, reporting lines or established authorities.

evidence.name: cc1-3-offboarding-sla-2026-08-29.csv
evidence.summary: Labelled fixture from the recorded private run: offboarding data showed three timely access revocations and one delayed revocation, but it did not document organisational structure, reporting lines or assigned authorities.

ruling.reasoning: The provided evidence consists of a security training completion report and an offboarding SLA tracking CSV. Neither of these artifacts documents the organization's structure, reporting lines, or defined authorities and responsibilities, which are the core requirements of CC1.3.
ruling.blocking_question: Please provide documentation demonstrating the established organisational structure, reporting lines and authorities, such as an organisational chart, job descriptions or an employee handbook outlining these structures.

evidence.name: cc8-102-branch-protection-2026-08-29.json
evidence.summary: Labelled fixture from the recorded private run: branch protection required one or two peer reviews across four repositories, but the artifact did not provide release approval evidence for the data platform.

evidence.name: cc8-102-secret-scanning-alerts.json
evidence.summary: Labelled fixture from the recorded private run: push protection was enabled with zero open secret-scanning alerts and three resolved alerts, but the artifact did not provide release approval evidence for the data platform.

ruling.reasoning: The provided evidence does not address the control requirement. The artifact 'cc8-102-branch-protection-2026-08-29.json' shows branch protection configurations for several repositories (atlas-api, atlas-web, billing, infra-tf), and 'cc8-102-secret-scanning-alerts.json' contains secret scanning alerts. Neither of these artifacts provides release approval evidence for the data platform on the documented cadence.
ruling.blocking_question: Please provide release approval evidence for the data platform, such as approved pull requests, change request approvals or release sign-offs covering the documented cadence within the audit period.

evidence.name: cc3-93-northwind-dpa.pdf
evidence.summary: Labelled fixture from the recorded private run: the vendor Data Processing Addendum had expired and remained unsigned for renewal, so it did not prove that a current sub-processor review was completed.

ruling.reasoning: The only evidence provided, cc3-93-northwind-dpa.pdf, is an expired Data Processing Addendum (expired March 1, 2026) that remains unsigned for renewal as of August 9, 2026. Consequently, there is no active, signed agreement or evidence demonstrating that a sub-processor review for Northwind Analytics, Inc. was successfully completed for the current audit period.
ruling.blocking_question: Please provide an executed current Data Processing Addendum or documented sub-processor review for Northwind Analytics, Inc. covering the current audit period.
